sentiment.label: risk_off
sentiment.reason_it: Il sentiment di mercato è risk-off a causa dell'aumento del VIX (+12.16%) e della debolezza dei mercati azionari, con S&P 500 in leggero aumento (+0.30%) ma accompagnato da una forte volatilità. Il DXY debole (-0.14%) non sostiene gli asset rischiosi. I tassi dei bond continuano a salire, con il TLT in calo (-0.52%) e il rendimento del 10Y USA al 4.55% (+0.35%). L'inflazione globale sembra persistente, con i prezzi alla produzione in Cina in aumento.
sentiment.reason_en: Market sentiment is risk-off due to the increase in VIX (+12.16%) and weakness in equity markets, with S&P 500 slightly up (+0.30%) but accompanied by high volatility. The weak DXY (-0.14%) does not support risky assets. Bond yields continue to rise, with TLT down (-0.52%) and the 10Y US yield at 4.55% (+0.35%). Global inflation appears persistent, with China's producer prices rising.

market_impact_summary.it: I mercati azionari sono deboli, con S&P 500 +0.30% e STOXX 600 -0.91%. Il VIX è salito a 21.22, segno di aumento della volatilità. I tassi di interesse continuano a salire, con il 10Y USA al 4.55%. Le materie prime sono miste, con il petrolio in calo (-0.31%) e l'oro in discesa (-1.64%).
market_impact_summary.en: Equity markets are weak, with S&P 500 +0.30% and STOXX 600 -0.91%. VIX rose to 21.22, indicating increased volatility. Interest rates continue to rise, with the 10Y US yield at 4.55%. Commodities are mixed, with oil down (-0.31%) and gold down (-1.64%).

audio_script_it:
Buongiorno, benvenuti al Morning Briefing di Price Alert.

Il Nikkei ha chiuso in rialzo dello 0.24%, Shanghai in rialzo dello 0.86%. Questo suggerisce un'apertura positiva per i mercati europei.

nella seduta precedente, l'S&P 500 ha chiuso in rialzo dello 0.3%, il VIX è salito del 12.16%, segnale di aumento dell'avversione al rischio. L'oro è sceso dell'1.64% a $4190/oncia, il petrolio è calato dello 0.31% a $91.17 Il rendimento del decennale USA è salito dello 0.35% al 4.55%, mentre il BTP 10Y si attesta al 3.73%.

La produzione industriale cinese ha aumentato i prezzi alla produzione al massimo degli ultimi 4 anni. Questo potrebbe influenzare la dinamica inflazionistica globale. Inoltre, le sfide fiscali e finanziarie dell'Ucraina sono sotto attenzione.

Oggi, attenzione ai dati sull'inflazione USA: CPI YoY e Core CPI YoY. Questi dati potrebbero influenzare le decisioni della Fed e quindi i mercati.

Passiamo ora al comparto degli asset digitali. 
  Bitcoin si mantiene sopra i sessantamila dollari, precisamente a sessantunomila centottanta dollari, con una variazione del -2,33%. 
  I flussi ETF mostrano un deflusso di novantuno virgola quattro milioni di dollari. 
  Questo movimento potrebbe essere influenzato dalle recenti dichiarazioni sui tassi di interesse e dalle condizioni di mercato.

  Tra le altcoin, Ethereum scambia a mille seicento diciannove dollari, con un calo del -3,08%. 
  Solana perde il -4,81% a sessantatre virgola trentasette dollari, mentre BNB scambia a cinquecento ottantaquattro virgola venticinque dollari, in ribasso del -2,67%.

  Il Fear & Greed Index è a nove, in zona di Extreme Fear, il che suggerisce cautela sugli investitori.

Outlook breve: oggi attenzione ai dati USA CPI YoY e Core CPI YoY. 
  Per approfondire, sulla nostra piattaforma trovate gli articoli completi nella sezione Storie in Primo Piano. 
  Grazie per l'attenzione e a domani.
audio_script_en:
Good morning, welcome to the Price Alert Morning Briefing. 

The Nikkei closed up 0.24%, Shanghai up 0.86%. This suggests a positive opening for European markets.

In the previous session, the S&P 500 closed up 0.3%, the VIX rose 12.16%, a signal of increased risk aversion. Gold fell 1.64% to $4,190/oz, oil dropped 0.31% to $91.17 The 10-year US yield rose 0.35% to 4.55%, while the 10Y BTP stands at 3.73%.

Chinese industrial production prices increased to a 4-year high. This could influence the global inflation dynamics. Additionally, Ukraine's fiscal and financial challenges are under attention.

Today, focus on US inflation data: CPI YoY and Core CPI YoY. These data points could influence the Fed's decisions and therefore the markets.

Let's pivot to the cryptocurrency markets... 
  Bitcoin holds above sixty thousand dollars, precisely at $61,180, with a variation of -2.33%. 
  ETF flows show an outflow of $91.4 million. 
  This movement could be influenced by recent statements on interest rates and market conditions.

  Among altcoins, Ethereum trades at $1,619, down -3.08%. 
  Solana loses -4.81% to $63.37, while BNB trades at $584.25, down -2.67%.

  The Fear & Greed Index is at 9, in Extreme Fear territory, suggesting investor caution.

Brief outlook: today focus on US CPI YoY and Core CPI YoY data. 
  For a deeper dive, find the full articles in the Top Stories section on our platform. 
  Thanks for your attention and see you tomorrow.

articles.title: From Pyongyang to Primorsk: When Sanctions Evasion Becomes System Design
articles.snippet: Rarely a week passes without a new story about Russia’s shadow fleet. Tankers catch fire in the Mediterranean, are added to sanctions lists, or are boarded while passing through European waters. But the bigger story is not the vessels that are caught, but those that aren’t — ships moving between registries, ports, shell companies, and service providers that obscure their ties to Russia while keeping a sanctioned state afloat. articles.title: Where Is China’s Trillion-Dollar Trade Surplus Going?
articles.snippet: Whereas China’s trade surplus used to be absorbed largely by the central bank and channeled into official reserves, it is now being redeployed by private actors in search of yield. This indicates China’s progress on financial deepening and underscores markets' increasingly central role in shaping the economy.

articles.title: Ukraine's fiscal and financial challenges
articles.snippet: As it faces the exigencies of an existential war, Ukraine is confronted with stark fiscal and financial policy trade-offs, despite the mitigation provided by large-scale external financial support. So far, its authorities have kept monetary and financial stability under control beyond a relatively brief initial episode of turmoil in 2022. articles.title: Dusting a Dirt Road: How The United States Can Break the Cycle of Failing Military Infrastructure
articles.snippet: Winter Storm Uri ripped through Texas in January 2021. The frigid temperatures froze pipes, which then burst and caused flooding in aging barracks at Fort Hood, many of which were overdue for renovations and had vulnerable mechanical and utility systems. The burst pipes, damaged sprinkler systems, and frozen heating, ventilation, and air conditioning coils affected over 30 barracks, forcing soldiers to relocate and causing nearly $50 million in damage.According to the Department of Defense’s reporting, the United States owns and operates more than 700,000 facilities across nearly 5,000 sites at home and abroad. articles.title: Why Is Europe’s Economy Falling Short?
articles.snippet: For much of the postwar era, European policymakers have prioritized stability and predictability over fostering breakthrough innovation. Today, as the United States and China compete for AI dominance, a stagnant Europe is struggling to regain its place at the technological frontier.
